full_arrow_label: Functional Defects in Training Code → Generated-Code Correctness Problems
wording_scope_note: Covers functional, executable, API, dependency, and obsolescence defects in code; corpus undercoverage and code Robustness remain separate.

full_arrow_label: Vulnerable Patterns in Training Code → Generated-Code Security Weaknesses
wording_scope_note: Limited to exploitable or insecure code patterns with a generated Security endpoint; Compliance outcomes route to F03.

full_arrow_label: Compliance-Risky or Sensitive Training Content → Generated-Code Compliance Problems
wording_scope_note: Covers code or text carrying licensing, privacy, harmful-content, or related governance risk when the generated endpoint is Compliance.

left_half_label: Fault-Tolerance and Validation Patterns in Training Code
full_arrow_label: Fault-Tolerance and Validation Patterns in Training Code → Generated-Code Robustness or Correctness Outcomes
wording_scope_note: Uses neutral pattern and outcome wording because accepted evidence includes an author hypothesis and a bundled cleaning intervention rather than two isolated harmful effects.

full_arrow_label: Structural Defects in Training Code → Generated-Code Maintainability Problems
wording_scope_note: Limited to structural evolvability and maintenance properties; clarity-only defects route to F05.

full_arrow_label: Clarity Defects in Training Code → Generated-Code Understandability Problems
wording_scope_note: Limited to intrinsic code-comprehension properties; paired instruction or comment mismatch routes to F07.

full_arrow_label: Inefficient Patterns in Training Code → Generated-Code Efficiency Problems
wording_scope_note: Limited to resource-wasting or algorithmically inefficient code patterns rather than data volume or training cost.

full_arrow_label: Training-Data Representation Imbalance → Uneven Generated-Code Quality
wording_scope_note: Requires comparative prevalence, representation, allocation, or distribution evidence; simple absence or insufficient coverage routes to F10.

right_half_label: Generated-Code Correctness Problems or Generation Derailment
full_arrow_label: Duplicate or Redundant Training Data → Generated-Code Correctness Problems or Generation Derailment
wording_scope_note: Limited to within-training duplication or repetition; training–evaluation overlap routes to F11.

right_half_label: Generated-Code Quality Gaps in Underexposed Areas
full_arrow_label: Insufficient Training-Data Coverage → Generated-Code Quality Gaps in Underexposed Areas
wording_scope_note: Covers missing or insufficient task, domain, language, API, temporal, security, performance, or format coverage without comparative prevalence evidence.

full_arrow_label: Training–Evaluation Contamination Risk → Familiarity-Associated Generated-Code Quality Differences
wording_scope_note: Covers verified overlap and explicitly qualified potential familiarity; within-training redundancy routes to F08.

right_half_label: Generated-Code Correctness, Security, or Understandability Problems
full_arrow_label: Low-Value or Misaligned Training Signals → Generated-Code Correctness, Security, or Understandability Problems
wording_scope_note: Residual non-code family for noisy, erroneous, low-information, irrelevant, malformed, or misaligned text, metadata, pairing, labels, instructions, comments, or context after the more specific corpus leaves are ruled out.
